title: Oven Roasted Malaysian Deodeok Root Skewers
description: A yeasty and flaky Malaysian dish featuring deodeok root, perfect for a cozy evening, and vegetarian friendly. This recipe uses a yakimono grill style for added flavor.

ingredients.name: deodeok root
ingredients.notes: peeled and cut into 1 inch pieces

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, soy sauce, honey, garlic, and ginger.
Add the deodeok root pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated deodeok root pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the sesame oil over the skewers and sprinkle with salt and black pepper.
Roast the skewers in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the deodeok root is tender and lightly browned.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
